source_note: The supplied archive contains official PS Store images, promotional/editorial images, trailer frames and four PS5 detail crops. Do not describe all 100 as independently verified PS5 captures. Source provenance here is transcribed from the supplied manifest.
scope: Each image was viewed separately and used to identify specific improvements or review existing support. Partially applied means named cues were transferred, not every object or scene was recreated. Context-only entries explicitly preserve their scope limits. Source images were not added as shipping game assets.
verification_scope: Validation paths identify shared production-component and regression checks for the listed code. They are not automated visual comparisons with each reference picture and do not establish complete scene recreation, full wet/night-race visual acceptance, or reference-specific parity. Every partially applied row has applicable shared checks. An empty validation list on a context or existing-support row claims no additional per-image verification.

status_scope.partially-applied: Named cues informed specific R2 changes; the complete depicted scene is not claimed as recreated.
status_scope.existing-support-reviewed: The primary depicted feature already existed and was reviewed. Any shared R2 improvements mentioned are cross-references, not a new implementation of that primary feature.
status_scope.context-only: The primary scene, discipline or mode remains context only. Related shared improvements are cross-references to other applied rows, not a newly implemented scene or mode.
